- Identify embedded screenshots (e.g., duplicated UI, rendering artifacts, visible borders)  
- Isolate each and assign a new context level:  
  - Top image = Level 1  
  - First embedded = Level 2  
  - Deeper = Level 3 … Level N  
- Process each level independently using attribution rules scoped to that level
